title: 第十四章 逃
content_zh:
柴房的门，是从外头闩死的。

    江砚扶着墙，挪到门边，借着门缝那一线微光，看清了门板的样子。这是间废弃的柴房，门板朽得厉害，木头都软了，闩门的，也不过是外头一根横插的木栓。

    他蹲下身，从门缝往外探，又用那把刀的刀尖，去撬门缝里那点能看见的木栓。

    刀短，缝窄，他的手又抖得厉害，撬了几下，没撬动。每动一下，胸口就一阵翻腾，那股虚脱牵着他，差点又栽倒。

    不行。这么撬，撬到天亮也撬不开。

    江砚喘着气，靠着门板缓了缓。

    他换了个法子。

    门板朽，他便不撬栓，直接对着门板下方那块最烂、最软的木头，用刀去刮、去剜。一刀一刀,慢，可那朽木经不住，木屑簌簌地往下掉。他剜出一个小口，又把刀别进去，用那点可怜的力气一点点地撬、扳。

    朽木“咔嚓“轻响着，一块一块地松动、剥落。

    不知过了多久，门板下方，被他生生剜、撬出了一个仅容一人钻过的破洞。

    冷风，“呼“地从洞口灌了进来，带着外头的雪粒，扑在他脸上。

    江砚趴下身，把那把刀先塞进怀里贴肉藏好，然后头朝外，一点一点地，从那破洞里往外钻。洞口的碎木茬刮破了他的后背和肩膀，火辣辣地疼，他咬着牙，一声不吭，硬是把整个人，从柴房里挪了出去。

    外头，是沈家院子的后角。

    天还黑着，雪不大不小地下着，院里那家丁不知缩到哪间屋里烤火去了，没人。

    江砚趴在雪地里，大口大口地喘着白气。冷空气一进肺，又勾得他一阵干咳，喉头那股腥甜还没散。他不敢咳出声，死死捂着嘴，把那口气憋了回去。

    不能停。

    他撑着雪地,半爬半挪地，贴着院墙根的阴影，往院门的方向蹭。每挪一步，都像耗尽了浑身的力气，眼前阵阵发黑。可他不敢停，一停，那股虚脱就要把他彻底拽进雪里去。

    院门虚掩着。

    他从门缝挤出去，一头扎进了门外那片茫茫的雪夜里。

    逃。
content_en:
The door of the woodshed is bolted from the outside.

    Jiang Yan held on to the wall and moved to the door. Through the glimmer of light in the crack of the door, he could clearly see the appearance of the door panel. This is an abandoned firewood shed. The door panels are badly rotted and the wood is soft. The door is only bolted with a wooden bolt inserted horizontally from the outside.

    He squatted down, leaned out from the crack of the door, and used the tip of the knife to pry the visible wooden bolt in the crack of the door.

    The knife was short and the slit was narrow, and his hands were shaking violently. He pried it several times but couldn't move it. Every time he moved, his chest was churning, and the exhaustion pulled him so hard that he almost fell down again.

    no. If you pry like this, you won't be able to pry it open until dawn.

    Jiang Yan gasped and leaned against the door panel to relax.

    He changed his approach.

    If the door panel was rotten, he would not pry the bolt, but directly use the knife to scrape and gouge out the worst and softest piece of wood under the door panel. Knife after knife, slowly, but the rotten wood couldn't stand it, and the wood chips fell down. He cut out a small opening, put the knife in, and used his pitiful strength to pry and pull bit by bit.

    The rotten wood crackled softly, loosening and peeling off piece by piece.

    After an unknown amount of time, he dug out and pried out a hole under the door panel that could only accommodate one person.

    The cold wind blew in from the entrance of the cave, carrying the snow particles from outside, and hit his face.

    Jiang Yan lay down, stuffed the knife into his arms and hid it against his flesh, then pointed his head outward and drilled out of the hole bit by bit. The broken wood at the entrance of the cave scratched his back and shoulders, causing burning pain. He gritted his teeth and moved his whole body out of the woodshed without saying a word.

    Outside, is the back corner of Shen's courtyard.

    It was still dark, and there was moderate snow falling. The servant in the courtyard had huddled up in some room to warm himself by the fire, but there was no one there.

    Jiang Yan lay on the snow, breathing heavily. As soon as the cold air entered his lungs, he coughed again, and the sweet smell in his throat still lingered. He didn't dare to cough, so he covered his mouth tightly and held back the breath.

    Can't stop.

    He held on to the snow, half crawled and half moved, leaning against the shadow of the courtyard wall, towards the courtyard gate. Every step he took seemed to have exhausted all his strength, and his eyesight turned black. But he didn't dare to stop. Once he stopped, the exhaustion would drag him completely into the snow.

    The courtyard door was ajar.

    He squeezed out through the crack of the door and plunged into the vast snowy night outside.

    escape.
